_about: Houses (where a person's thread runs) and dyes for loom-view/1 (proto/contracts/loom-view.md). Written from memory by the merge analyst, not looked up (no web lookups in this stage): seat coordinates are standard city or house values, grade Likely, prov model_recall, the same convention as places.json; which branch label names which house is the merge analyst's reading of the harvesters' labels, grade Likely; colours are Illustrative. `labels` are the branch strings the sources use for the house; `family_labels` are branch strings that name a family, not a house (the fact-check Darwin-Wedgwood file puts the birth family in `branch`), so they never place anyone. opened/closed are not written here: loomview.py computes them from the data (first birth and last death of the house's core members; closed is null while a core member is presumed living).
